subject: Superintendent Performance Evaluation
overview: The School Committee met to review and discuss the annual performance evaluation for Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent, approving the composite evaluation as amended. The committee also formally approved its meeting calendar for the 2022–2023 school year.

items.title: Superintendent Performance Evaluation
items.summary: The committee discussed the state evaluation framework, performance goals, and individual category ratings for Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent, approving the evaluation as amended to include missing committee feedback.

items.title: 2022–2023 School Committee Meeting Calendar
items.summary: Approved the regular meeting dates for the 2022–2023 school year.
